objective: Define and prove the first authenticated, policy-governed context and memory path with rebuildable semantic indexes and lifecycle propagation.

external_actions: run synthetic container integration on the dev NUC

allowed_changes: derived index invalidation and rebuild paths
synthetic fixtures, tests, documentation, and evidence
non_goals: ingestion of real personal, health, or financial data
production key custody or off-prem backup deployment
validation: synthetic container integration and restart/rebuild proof
rollback: disable the v1 memory route behind its feature boundary
rebuild disposable derived views from authoritative records

handoff.current_state: Governed-memory v1 contracts and context retrieval/invalidation are merged with open-vocabulary domains, deterministic pre-ranking filters, bounded cited packets, and derived-view invalidation receipts.
handoff.next_action: Design the usage-driven taxonomy proposal and activation lifecycle before adding storage-tier and rebuild workers.
known_limits: taxonomy proposal scoring and activation are not implemented
physical key separation and backup restore are not implemented
derived-view rebuild workers and embedding migration are not implemented
